root.note: No class: the stylesheet styles headings by context (.salt-block > h*, card titles). The level is data, never a tag the author picked.

zeroState: Not drawn when its text is empty after trimming.

notes.text: Visual size is decoupled from level by context in the stylesheet, so WordPress's size argument (xl, lg, md, sm) and its utility classes go.

owes: Drop x-heading and size classes; take the id when it names a section.
